strategy_name: Digital Product Price Ladder — Fee Efficiency Principle
description: Etsy fees as % of revenue SHRINK as price rises: $7.99=15.1% fee drag, $14.99=12.5% fee drag, $24.99=11.3% fee drag. Every price increase delivers DOUBLE benefit: more revenue AND better margin %. Never discount digital products — the math always punishes it. Price digital planners at $17.99+ and art bundles at $14.99+ for maximum margin efficiency. Single art prints floor: $9.99 (not $7.99) to capture the 86%+ margin tier.
outcome: Digital margins 84.8%–88.7% across all price points, all exceeding 70% target. Fee efficiency gains of 3.8 percentage points from $7.99 to $24.99.
applicable_when: Pricing any new digital product, reviewing existing digital listing prices, evaluating bundle vs. single pricing strategy

strategy_name: Gallery Wall Bundle — Lifestyle Thumbnail Formula (Boho Botanical)
description: For boho botanical gallery wall sets: (1) Warm greige/linen wall — NOT white background. (2) Thin gold frames, all prints in same consistent palette. (3) Anchor piece centered and slightly larger, companions arranged around it. (4) 65–75% print fill per frame. (5) 2 props max at base: eucalyptus stem + sage green ceramic vase. (6) Linen fabric corner accent. (7) Zero text overlay on main thumbnail — art sells itself. (8) Secondary image: 2x2 grid on cream background showing all pieces individually. This formula is confirmed by market research for CTR performance in boho home decor niche.
outcome: Confirmed highest CTR format for boho botanical wall art category based on top Etsy seller analysis — lifestyle greige wall scene outperforms white background mockups in this niche
